text: Computers don’t understand language the way we do, but natural language processing, or NLP, helps them make sense of our words. One important use is machine translation, like turning an English email into Spanish in seconds. Another common application is sentiment analysis, where companies examine customer reviews to decide if people feel positive or negative about a product. Perhaps the most familiar example is the chatbot you find on websites, which can answer simple questions and guide you to the right page. All these tools work because NLP breaks language into patterns, allowing machines to handle text in a surprisingly human-like way.
